what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from China in Italy: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5365 Chinese asylum seekers in Italy, 5.4% of all asylum seekers from China.
Refugees from China, a separate group, live mostly in India, the United States, France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records an armed conflict over East Turkestan territory in China with ETIM in 2008, and an interstate armed conflict between China and India in 2020.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 11 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, the main year of displacement in the data.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Italy only.
